title: Desk reset
brief: A fictional stationery campaign. No brand logo. A coral notebook helps organise a daily list; do not claim productivity metrics.
prompt: Square 1:1 commercial illustration. Warm ivory paper, one large coral closed notebook with cream elastic band, surrounded by crisp lively navy ink doodles: a pencil, three simple check marks, a small sun and flowing curved lines connecting them. The notebook dominates the lower middle. Sophisticated hand-ink aesthetic with subtle paper texture, restrained mustard accents, generous breathing room. Top headline exactly "Make room for ideas" in large beautifully set dark navy type. Bottom small text exactly "Start with a page". No logos, no watermarks, no placeholder text, no metrics, no extra words. Professional independent stationery campaign, clear readable hierarchy. Standalone finished image, not a mockup sheet.
usage: Use in an organic social post or display creative where a simple product idea needs a more human, illustrated treatment.

title: Coffee ritual
brief: A fictional cafe takeaway campaign. No brand logo or price. Warm coffee cup surrounded by a small morning ritual.
prompt: Square 1:1 commercial doodle poster. Center-left a beautifully illustrated cream reusable coffee cup with burnt-orange lid, drawn in a tactile gouache-and-ink style, no label or logo. Rich deep blue background; playful cream hand-drawn orbit of a sunrise, spoon, tiny croissant and steam curls, all supporting the cup without covering it. One large cream headline on the upper right exactly "A little morning magic". One small footer exactly "Take a moment". Warm orange and pale yellow accents, intentional editorial asymmetry, premium cafe advertising. No extra text, no prices, no environmental promises, no watermark. One finished image.
usage: Use in an organic social post or display creative where a simple product idea needs a more human, illustrated treatment.
